text_post:
Your PC isn't slow. It's crowded.
Press Ctrl + Shift + Esc to open Task Manager.
Click Startup apps.
Everything marked Enabled starts when you sign in.
Select what you don't need and click Disable.
Which app was hiding in your list? 👇
